personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center that prioritizes glanceability, live metrics, and authoritative trading signals.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for sections, but tight spacing for related numeric data. Keep touch targets at 44pt minimum.

do's: Use heavy blur to obscure signal cards in the Non-Premium locked state.
Use blur for the sticky CTA background in the Trader Profile Modal.
dont's: Do not use blur on standard data cards or metrics to maintain contrast.

screens.name: Trader Profile Modal
screens.purpose: A selection modal for trader types, acting as the entry point for the AI Suggestions premium feature.
screens.layout: Vertical stack of 4 selectable profile cards (Scalper, Day Trader, Swing, Long-term) inside a bottom sheet or modal. Unselected cards use surfaceSecondary and border. Selected card uses surfaceTertiary with borderStrong (brand/gold) and a check icon. The bottom area must contain a sticky absolute/fixed container with a glass/blur background housing a full-width Gold primary CTA button: '✨ AI Suggestions — PREMIUM'.

screens.name: AI Suggestions Bottom Sheet
screens.purpose: A premium command center displaying high-confidence AI trading signals, lock-gated for non-subscribers.

states.empty: No signals available for this category. Show an empty state icon and text.
states.locked: Displays a blurred list of dummy signal cards underneath. On top, a centered container (surfaceSecondary) with a Gold LockKey icon, a title 'Fitur Premium', a subtitle explaining the feature, and a Gold 'Upgrade ke Premium' CTA.

screens.layout: Header with 'AI Suggestions' title. Below it, a sticky horizontally scrolling chip row for categories (Crypto, Saham IDX, World Stock, Gold, Commodity, Forex). The main scroll view contains a list of expandable Asset Cards. Each card (closed state) shows Symbol, Live Price, 24h Change, Long/Short direction chip, and AI Confidence %. Tapping the card expands it to reveal a tactical grid: Entry Zone, Stop Loss (SL), Take Profit (TP1/2/3), R:R ratio, Daily Bias, and Pattern Reason, ending with a 'Buka Detail Aset' secondary button.

premium_abstract_bg.alt: Abstract dark and gold premium luxury background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 7 Dark-First Utility personality. The interface must feel like a live, tactical command center. Do not use rounded, playful, or soft iOS-native aesthetics.

Typography MUST use Barlow Condensed for numbers, prices, tickers, and display metrics. Use Satoshi for standard body text (reasons, labels). Let the font sizes create hierarchy, keep weight to 400/500.
For the Long/Short chips: Use the 'success' token (#22C55E) for LONG/BUY and the 'error' token (#EF4444) for SHORT/SELL. Do not use generic blue or purple.
Asset Cards must be expandable (accordion style). When expanded, the numeric data (Entry, SL, TP) should be laid out in a dense, highly scannable grid using dividers, not floating cards.

LOCKED STATE: Non-premium users must see the actual UI structure, but heavily obscured using expo-blur. Place a premium upsell overlay (Lock icon, text, Gold CTA) vertically centered over the blurred content. This is a critical conversion mechanism.

Trader Profile modal must have a sticky absolute CTA for 'AI Suggestions — PREMIUM' at the bottom. Use a glassmorphism (blurred) background container behind the button so scrolling profiles pass underneath it cleanly.
